hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) RUFF="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$RUFF" ] || RUFF=ruff; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { "$RUFF" check . && "$RUFF" format --check . ; } 1>&2 || { echo "ruff failed — fix lint before pushing" 1>&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
